name: tasklane
description: MCP-native task board for coding agent workflows. Open the native TaskLane panel through MCP from a project conversation or global navigation.

interface.shortDescription: Task board shared by you and the agent
interface.longDescription: TaskLane shares board management and correlated Codex native execution requests, real chat bindings and receipts. Connected Codex panels submit explicit tasks directly; native tools are checked within each task and ready chat identifiers are bound before execution.
capabilities: Verified native chat and workspace binding
defaultPrompt: Open the TaskLane native panel for this project through MCP.
Open the global TaskLane board through MCP.
Create a task for adding dark-mode support; execution is requested separately from the task details.
Show what's currently doing on the board.
